visualReview.notes: Inspected 63 current frames during one author/inspect/fix pass: 12 portable, 12 shared, 28 medium-fi and 11 native. Paired white portal towers, continuous main cables with exact saddle knots, inclined hangers, full shallow aerofoil deck and separate footways, piers and anchorages remain. Automatic near reductions had fragmented rails/cables; street and closeup now use independent analytic structural geometry with the complete 344-hanger schedule and continuous rails. Distant anchorage bases were lowered beneath the road, retaining separate side cable blocks and an open outer walking route. The 308648-triangle detailed shared-material source and canonical runtime master remain byte-exact.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Two existing 256px shared graphs, metal_painted and concrete_plain, supply painted steel and low-frequency aggregate. Metric UVs and restrained source paint/road tints; no embedded images, private atlas or copied photographic pixels. Three textured material groups/draws share these two graph resources, read once each; skyline bakes shared means into vertex colors in one draw. Separate GPU attribute streams and complete model geometry disposal pass. Source parapet pickets retain their fine original rhythm; runtime levels choose explicitly spaced rails/pickets instead of noisy decimation.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four complete authored LODs: 994/3952/14792/53752 triangles; initial skyline + district 436984 bytes. Closeup is 4103664 bytes. Skyline/district use representative paired hangers; near levels retain the full hanger schedule and source portal shapes. Street pickets are spaced 16m, closeup 2m, detailed master 0.75m. Economy/high, noon/late, near/far, silhouette and four transitions inspected under the shared Earth rig. Geometry/download budgets pass; physical laptop/phone timings remain pending.

geographicReview.notes: Approximate native fit approved at [-2.6399325393140316,51.609817360632036], heading -0.5492121314969372, with +X toward Aust (east/southeast). Original M48 crossing Q1850537; not the second Severn crossing. Retains 987.5m main span, 305m side spans and 1597.5m suspended road. Simplified anchorage exteriors extend to 1637.5m. Local Y=0 is an approximate sea-plane reference, not a reconciled tidal/survey datum. All four mapped carriageway joins at x=±799m meet the 32m end deck within 0.005m. The independent eastern approach begins its inferred descent (31.28m at x=820m); the western approach remains near32m. These grades fit ordinary pictures and current PMTiles/Mapzen but are not surveyed engineering profiles.

runtimePreservation.notes: All 33 resident / 97 wider original mapped buildings remain; no building footprint is replaced. Native Aust/Beachley/Wye approach bridge geometry and unrelated roads stay independent. Only road geometry overlapping the authored suspension footprint is replaced, with connected approach height hints. Every original DEM sample, source road input and native estuary/shoreline behavior remains. Failed model load retains the original procedural crossing without inferred supports. Unload releases all model geometry and restores native content. Native captures use the actual client directional-shadow focus helper; fixture and engine source hashes are pinned. Separate unique approach viaduct models, traffic, interiors, exact tide and engineering grades remain outside this scoped suspension/anchorage asset.

limitations: The 308648-triangle shared-material detailed master remains exact. Browser models preserve paired portals, connected main cables, inclined hangers, complete aerofoil roadway and footways, piers and anchorages.
Source nominal dimensions, local sea-plane datum, sag/grade and fittings remain photo/map approximations; this is not a reconciled tidal or engineering survey.

Skyline/district use representative paired hangers. Near levels retain the 344-hanger schedule, continuous cables and rails; parapet pickets are spaced 16 m on street and 2 m on closeup, while the master retains the fine original 0.75 m rhythm.

Separate Aust/Beachley/Wye approach structures use the independent native procedural bridge renderer. Their detailed unique models, current traffic, interiors, exact endpoint grades and physical device timings are outside this asset.
